content:
Luca: Heads up — landing in Milano Centrale tomorrow, sticking around Brera. Looking for aperitivo spots + sturdy train snacks for a 2hr ride to Turin. Any recs?

Giulia: For aperitivo try 'N'Ombra de Vin' (Brera) — great wine bar and board snacks. Timing: 6-9pm classic aperitivo window.

Marco: If you want cheap but very Milanese, 'Bar Luce' (Fondazione Prada) is cool vibe for a prosecco and frittini.

Sara: Train snacks: Panini from 'Princi' travel well and they open early. Also grab an arancino from the bakery if you like fried rice balls.

Priyanka: Vegan option for aperitivo: 'Vegan Come Milano' does small plates and decent cocktails. For snacks, try focaccia with rosemary (stays fine on trains).

Luca: Any addresses? Can someone drop a short list I can copy to my phone?

Giulia: Quick list:
```
N'Ombra de Vin — Via San Marco 2, Brera
Bar Luce — Largo Isarco 2, Fondazione Prada
Princi — Piazza XXV Aprile 5
Vegan Come Milano — Via Carlo Imbonati 6
Milano Centrale kiosks — main concourse (for arancini/packaged snacks)
```

Marco: Pro tip: get a takeaway olive oil cake (torta) from Princi — surprisingly good on the train. Also cash is handy for tiny bars.

Sara: If anyone wants to join aperitivo Thurs 7pm, say so and I'll see if we can snag a table.

lunchbot: Poll created "Aperitivo Thu 7pm?" Options: 1) Yes 2) No 3) Maybe. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Priyanka: Voted :one:, can bring a small GF snack pack.

Luca: Thanks all — will ping when I land and post which platform I'm at. Appreciated! :)
